description: Implementation of the AudioStreamOutSink class for managing audio output streams, including negotiation, writing data, timestamp retrieval, and mel (audio feature) processing control.

classes.name: AudioStreamOutSink
classes.description: A class that manages audio output stream, handles negotiation, data writing, timestamp retrieval, and mel processing.

methods.name: negotiate
methods.description: Negotiates audio format with the stream, initializes format and frame size if not valid, and updates mel processor.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes audio data to the stream, processes sound dose measurement, and updates frames written count.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves presentation position and timestamp from the stream.

methods.name: startMelComputation
methods.description: Starts mel (audio feature) computation with the provided processor.
